doc.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: Cornet bore and tone compared to trumpet and flugelhorn
summary: The mellow tone comes from the conical bore, not the horn's age.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Did it help to have an older horn for that sound?

Well it’s not really the age, it’s the configuration of the pipe. Like it starts smaller than a trumpet here, and keeps getting larger and larger. These are different sizes. And so it’s more conical and it has a more characteristically mellow tone — not as much as the flugelhorn, but kind of halfway between.
